test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: An iron ball of radius 20 cm is melted and recast into 64 spherical balls of same radius. Find the radius of each spherical ball.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of iron ball (R) = 20 cm

Number of small balls (n) = 64

Radius of each small ball (r) = ?

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³

Volume of ir
on ball = Volume of 64 small balls

(4)/(3)pi R³ = 64 times (4)/(3)pi r³

**Calculations:**

(4)/(3)pi (20)³ = 64 times (4)/(3)pi r³

⇒ 20³ = 64 times r³

⇒ 8000 = 64 times r³

⇒ r³ = (8000)/(64)

⇒ r³ = 125

⇒ r = 5 cm

**∴ The radius of each spherical ball is 5 cm.**
